body.statement: For every \(\alpha>0\), \(h<c\), and sufficiently small \(0<\rho<\min\{h,1-c\}\), the construction \((P_{\mathrm{lf}},\eta_{\mathrm{lf}})\) belongs to \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm m}(\alpha,h^{-\alpha})\), satisfies \(\|s-e\|_\infty=\rho\) with the true outcome regressions, and obeys \[R(P_{\mathrm{lf}},\eta_{\mathrm{lf}})=\frac{\delta\alpha}{(\alpha+1)h^\alpha}\rho^{1+\alpha}.\] Hence the exponent \(1+\alpha\) cannot be improved uniformly for this unsmoothed one-step correction over the stated cap-shell class. This is sharpness of the correction modulus, not a minimax lower bound over all estimators.
body.justification: The equality witness distinguishes a sharp cap-crossing modulus from a merely sufficient margin bound.
body.gap: Audibert and Tsybakov establish the generic classification exponent; the legal causal witness preserves the capped intervention, treatment law, bounded outcomes, and exact one-step signal.
body.consumer: Method developers obtain a hard threshold for nuisance rates below which the unsmoothed correction cannot have negligible root-\(n\) bias.
